import hashlib,json,math,sys
from pathlib import Path
base=Path(r"C:\Users\gb\.codex\tmp\pvground_reference_keep_20261006")
source=base.parent/"pvground_mask_reference_20261006/complete_fit/fused_mask_reference/initial_formal"
out=base/"cached_reference_errors"
rowsfile=source/"rows.jsonl"
receipt=json.loads((source/"receipt.json").read_bytes())
summary=json.loads((out/"SUMMARY.json").read_bytes())
execution=json.loads((out/"EXECUTION.json").read_bytes())
rows=[json.loads(x) for x in rowsfile.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
assert len(rows)==9508 and [r["row_id"] for r in rows]==list(range(9508))
assert hashlib.sha256(rowsfile.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==receipt["rows_sha256"]==summary["source_rows_sha256"]==execution["input_rows_sha256"]
assert hashlib.sha256((out/"SUMMARY.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest()==execution["summary_sha256"]
assert hashlib.sha256((base/"postrun/analyze_cached_reference_errors.py").read_bytes()).hexdigest()==execution["final_source_sha256"]
assert receipt["status"]=="pass" and receipt["formal_rows"]==9508 and summary["source_model_hits"]==[5598,4848]
def interval_box(box):
    assert len(box)==6 and all(math.isfinite(v) for v in box) and all(v>0 for v in box[3:])
    return tuple((c-s/2,c+s/2) for c,s in zip(box[:3],box[3:]))
def intersection_vol(a,b):
    return math.prod(max(0.0,min(x[1],y[1])-max(x[0],y[0])) for x,y in zip(a,b))
def median(values):
    ordered=sorted(values);n=len(ordered)
    return ordered[n//2] if n%2 else (ordered[n//2-1]+ordered[n//2])/2
features={}
calc={}
max_iou_diff={"prior":0.0,"reference":0.0}
threshold_flips={"prior":{"0.25":0,"0.5":0},"reference":{"0.25":0,"0.5":0}}
for r in rows:
    b=r["bbs"];g=r["root_box"];ref=b["reference_box"];prior=b["coarse_box"]
    assert b["box"]==ref and b["iou"]==b["reference_iou"]
    gv=math.prod(g[3:]);rv=math.prod(ref[3:])
    gi=interval_box(g);ri=interval_box(ref);pi=interval_box(prior)
    intersect=intersection_vol(gi,ri)
    calc[r["row_id"]]={}
    for name,box,axes,logged in (("prior",prior,pi,b["coarse_iou"]),("reference",ref,ri,b["iou"])):
        inter=intersection_vol(gi,axes)
        iou=inter/(gv+math.prod(box[3:])-inter)
        calc[r["row_id"]][name]=iou
        max_iou_diff[name]=max(max_iou_diff[name],abs(iou-logged))
        for t in (.25,.5):
            threshold_flips[name][str(t)]+=int((iou>t)!=(logged>t))
    f={"row_id":r["row_id"],"scan_id":r["scan_id"],"target_id":r["target_id"],"query":b["query"],"prior_iou":b["coarse_iou"],"reference_iou":b["iou"],"mask_iou":b["mask_iou"],"reference_valid":b["reference_valid"],"reference_to_gt_volume_ratio":rv/gv,"gt_volume_covered":intersect/gv,"max_absolute_face_error_m":max(abs(x[k]-y[k]) for x,y in zip(ri,gi) for k in (0,1)),"reference_box":ref,"prior_box":prior,"root_gt":g}
    features[r["row_id"]]=f
result={}
cohort_ids={}
all_features_exact=True
for t in (.25,.5):
    name=str(t)
    prior_hits=sum(calc[r["row_id"]]["prior"]>t for r in rows)
    reference_hits=sum(calc[r["row_id"]]["reference"]>t for r in rows)
    result[name]={"prior_hits":prior_hits,"reference_hits":reference_hits}
    for direction in ("repaired","damaged"):
        key=name+"_"+direction
        expected=[r["row_id"] for r in rows if ((calc[r["row_id"]]["prior"]<=t<calc[r["row_id"]]["reference"]) if direction=="repaired" else (calc[r["row_id"]]["reference"]<=t<calc[r["row_id"]]["prior"]))]
        saved=[json.loads(x) for x in (out/(key+".jsonl")).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
        assert [r["row_id"] for r in saved]==expected
        assert len(expected)==len(set(expected))
        assert saved==[features[rowid] for rowid in expected],key
        cohort_ids[key]=expected
        cohort=[features[i] for i in expected]
        rec={"rows":len(cohort),"mask_good50":sum(r["mask_iou"]>.5 for r in cohort),"invalid_reference":sum(not r["reference_valid"] for r in cohort),"gt_covered95_and_reference_volume_over4":sum(r["gt_volume_covered"]>=.95 and r["reference_to_gt_volume_ratio"]>4 for r in cohort),"gt_coverage_below95":sum(r["gt_volume_covered"]<.95 for r in cohort),"median_reference_to_gt_volume_ratio":median([r["reference_to_gt_volume_ratio"] for r in cohort]),"median_gt_volume_covered":median([r["gt_volume_covered"] for r in cohort]),"median_max_face_error_m":median([r["max_absolute_face_error_m"] for r in cohort])}
        assert rec==summary["cohorts"][key],key
        result[name][direction]=rec
    result[name]["net"]=result[name]["repaired"]["rows"]-result[name]["damaged"]["rows"]
    assert result[name]["net"]==reference_hits-prior_hits
    assert reference_hits==receipt["metrics"]["bbs"]["rec_hits"+("25" if t==.25 else "50")]
d25=set(cohort_ids["0.25_damaged"]);d50=set(cohort_ids["0.5_damaged"])
overlap={"damaged_at_both_thresholds":len(d25&d50),"wide_damage_only":len(d25-d50),"strict_damage_only":len(d50-d25)}
assert all(summary[k]==v for k,v in overlap.items())
assert summary["new_model_evaluations"]==summary["new_optimizer_steps"]==summary["remote_queries"]==0
assert execution["new_optimizer_steps"]==execution["remote_queries"]==0 and execution["training_modified"] is False
paths=[base/"postrun/analyze_cached_reference_errors.py",out/"SUMMARY.json",out/"EXECUTION.json",source/"receipt.json",rowsfile]+[out/(name+".jsonl") for name in cohort_ids]
identities=[{"path":str(p),"bytes":p.stat().st_size,"sha256":hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in paths]
print(json.dumps({"status":"INDEPENDENT_STDLIB_CACHED_RECOUNT_PASS","python":sys.version,"interpreter":sys.executable,"source_rows":len(rows),"all_final_boxes_equal_reference":True,"cohort_feature_rows_checked":sum(len(v) for v in cohort_ids.values()),"feature_rows_exact":True,"all_summary_fields_exact":True,"coordinate_iou_threshold_flips":threshold_flips,"coordinate_iou_max_absolute_difference_from_logged_float32":max_iou_diff,"recomputed":result,"overlap":overlap,"reviewed_files":identities,"source_runner_imported_or_executed":False,"model_inference_or_optimizer_steps":0,"remote_queries":0},ensure_ascii=False))
